positions.title: Engineering Resident
positions.description: I am enrolled in the Engineering Resident program, designed to put us residents through training and rotations throughout the year. Throughout the program, I will be learning good practices as a programmer as well as being an employee at Google.

positions.title: Cloud Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked in Prudential's Global Business Technology Solutions department under the platform engineering team. My team works with AWS Cloud Formation to deploy infrastructure for business units. On a daily basis, my manager will assign me a task given by a business unit, and I will create the cloud formation stack, test it, and upload it to the business units' repositories. This involves me reading a lot of documentation and learning as I go.

positions.title: Project Management Intern
positions.description:
I worked at Prudential's Global Business Technology Solutions department under the Intake team for the summer of 2018. During my time, I've assisted my team in the intake process for every project request coming in while also working on automating the same intake process using ServiceNow and Visio.
Another project that I had the pleasure of working on was the Strengthsfinder Initiative. My partner and I had our intern class take the Strengthsfinder survey (Gallup), and we used Tableau to analyze the data we gathered from the interns. There was a debrief activity held for the interns where my partner, our managers, and I explained Strengthsfinder and conducted activities in which we demonstrate how they can utilize their strengths. I then took data from years prior when previous employees took the survey in order to make an interactive dashboard for everyone in the Application and Business Solutions department to use to for team-making and basic lookup.
